tagline: A quiet, residential Asian side neighbourhood between Göztepe and Erenköy — peaceful streets, good local services, and an authentic non-touristy Istanbul experience.

items.name: Feneryolu Mahalle Kafeler
items.description: Small neighbourhood cafés serving the local community. Very local, very quiet, and a genuine slice of everyday Asian side Istanbul.

items.name: Feneryolu Lokantalari
items.description: Honest lokanta restaurants serving the neighbourhood. Traditional Turkish home cooking at prices that haven't been inflated by tourism.

tips: Feneryolu is a quiet residential neighbourhood — not a destination but a comfortable place to live.
Good transport connections to Kadıköy and the wider Asian side.
Property is more affordable than neighbouring Moda or Kadıköy centre.
Göztepe Park (nearby) is the best outdoor amenity in the immediate area.
